    sum(status >= 500) as status5xx,
    avg(responseLatency) as LatenciaPromedio

| sort resourcePath asc

properties.query:
SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/securityws-mngr" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/remittancesws-mngr" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/productsws-mngr" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/paymentsws-mngr" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/loansws-mngr" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/investmentsws-mngr" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/insurancesws-mngr" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/credit-cardsws-mngr" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/clientsws-mngr" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/acquiringws-mngr" | SOURCE "/aws/ecs/srv/accountsws-mngr" |
fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log
|filter @message LIKE "::AUDIT::REQ::" or @message like "::AUDIT::RESP::"
|parse @message "::HTTPCODE::*" as CodesHTTP
|parse @message "::[X-RqUid=*,X-Name=PN-" as RqUidReq
|parse @message "X-Referer=*,X-RqUid=*,X" as ApiCliente , RqUidResp
|#filter CodesHTTP > 399
|parse @message /BODY::(?<body>\{.*\})/ 
|display jsonParse(body) as body1
|filter ispresent(CodesHTTP)  and ispresent (body1.error.system)
|display  CodesHTTP  , body1.error.code  , body1.error.system  , body1.error.message  , body1.from.productType  , coalesce(RqUidResp,RqUidReq) as RqUid , ApiCliente , substr(@log,13) as logroup
|#filter RqUid like "{{rquid}}"
|stats count (*) as CantReq  by  body1.error.message , body1.error.system ,  logroup
| sort CantReq desc , logroup asc
| limit 1000
properties.title: SUMATORIA EVENTOS  APIS

fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log
|filter @message LIKE "RSOUT" 
|PARSE @message "dt.trace_id=*" AS traceid
|PARSE @message "1=*" as statusCode
| parse @message /\(executor-thread-\d+\) \[(?<var1>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<canal>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<var3>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<var4>[^\]]+)\]/

| sort cantidadReq desc
